questions.questionText:
The increased availability of nitrates in rivers and lakes can result in the death of fish.
Which statement explains why fish die in rivers and lakes containing a high concentration of
nitrates?

options.text: The increase in water plants stops the fish swimming.
There is an increase in anaerobic respiration by plants.
There are fewer water plants for fish to eat.

There is an increase in aerobic respiration by decomposers.
